brief: Goldman FICC and Equities daily, 10 September 2026, four subjects. Communacopia Day 2 read bullish. BKNG, TOST, Block and ETSY confirmed steady, resilient consumer demand with no macro-driven deterioration, AI is accelerating business activity (CDNS chip design, DT consumption above 20%, SNDK muted NAND supply against rising inference demand, MiniMax ARR ramp despite compute bottlenecks), and AI plus flatter structures turn fixed costs into operating leverage. Guidance: VZ at the top end of 750k to 1 million 2026 postpaid net adds, CMCSA modest broadband ARPU and EBITDA gains from 3Q26 despite competitive pressure, CCI reiterating $60-70 million leasing, NXPI raising prices. Second, US fundamental L/S gross and net leverage stand at 207% and 49.8%, the 20th and 6th percentiles versus the past year, therefore rallies are being chased. Garret's evidence: SPX rallies run almost twice as volatile as sell-offs and call implieds correlate more to spot, not a market full on exposure. Third, short the GSXUSWCH consumer-inertia basket against a sector-neutral hedge, because AI agents cut switching costs and pressure profit pools built on customer inaction. Fourth, $135 billion year-to-date USD convertible volume, 44% from AI borrowers on GS estimates, a channel GS says offers upside convexity.
